title: I Didn’t Expect My Cat to React Like This to Our New Kitty 🥹 #CuteCats
description:
I thought Max would be jealous when we brought home Honey… but instead, he became the sweetest little dad. 🥹🤍 The way he grooms her and snuggles her is too precious.

Have you ever seen a cat act this protective of another cat?

#Shorts #Cats #CuteCats
